== Acquisition ==
* [[Kurzick Bureaucrat]] ([[House zu Heltzer]] and [[Kurzick]]-allied [[guild hall]]s)
* [[Luxon Scavenger]] ([[Cavalon]] and [[Luxon]]-allied guild halls)

== Notes ==
* Good [[adrenaline]] management is essential to quickly refill the adrenaline pool of this skill to make up for its short duration. 
** [["For Great Justice!"]] works well in that regard, as it is also a warrior skill and does not require any investment. 
* After reaching the first [[allegiance rank]], Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, [[level]] 20 [[character]]s may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The [[skill icon]] for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* +100 armor reduces non-[[armor-ignoring damage]] by 82.3%.
* An [[Imbagon]] is a paragon build that maintains both "Save Yourselves!" and [["There's Nothing to Fear!"]] for up to 88.5% total damage reduction on other party members.
{{Anomaly|The skill descriptions omit that only party members within [[earshot]] are affected.}}

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|"Watch Yourself!"}}

==Trivia==
* Unlike other [[allegiance skill]]s, the maximum effectiveness of "Save Yourselves!" is reached at rank 5 instead of 6.
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
